subject: App Live screen is built on a sensing stub; here is what it calls
body: lane/experience app/src/stubs/sensing.ts calls start(profile, onEvent, {host, stateId, onFrame, onGate}) -> {stop, triggerManual}. Frames come at 1 Hz with scenarioStep baseline|drift|recovery. onGate fires every 5 s with {consecutive, required, refractoryRemainingS, sham, confidence}. The stub drifts from the peak band toward the contrast band at 3 s, so the 3-window gate opens at about 20 s, then recovers. The chart draws mean ±2 sd bands from state.calibration.peak and .contrast. Pacing goes through host.clock.speed so the demo can fast-forward. If your real API differs, tell me and I'll adapt the slot; contracts is typing GateState.
